messages.subject: Residualized factor scores Lavpredict
parts:
Dear all,

I am using the LavPredict function to predict the residualized factors using the following code. Would these lines of code predict the residualized factor or the fitted factor score?
 
  model <-'
# Factor model
Factor =~ x1+x2+x3+x4
# Reg to residualize factors of controls age and gender
Factor ~ age + gender
'
fit <- sem(model, data=dt.data )
residuals <-as.data.frame(lavPredict(fit )) 


Many thanks

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Residualized factor scores Lavpredict
parts: Would these lines of code predict the residualized factor or the fitted factor score?

The marginal scores.  This is what is meant on the help page: "the structural component is completely ignored (for now)."

messages.subject: Re: Residualized factor scores Lavpredict
parts:
what do you mean by marginal scores? 
Do you mean the residualized factor scores
Residuals are conditional on the predictors.  Marginal is not conditional, it is averaged across levels of the predictor(s).
